description: Land Title Settlement Department - Mallawapitiya, Mallawapitiya D/S Division, Kurunegala District - Cad. Map No. 420201 and others
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, extents, owner details, and encumbrances) in various locations. The content falls under "Land registrations, property ownership, land titles" as specified in the Land Gazettes (Type 4) category. There is no government personnel or structural changes, legal/regulatory framework creation, commercial matters, or other specialized categories present - the focus is purely on land title settlement and registration.
